exact_prompt:

InputImage1 is the ENTIRE exact original native storedRGB, not a nearest-enlarged or altered guide. Preserve entireUV/layout/sourcepaintblur/material/nativepaintscale/palette. Output same wholeaspect, no separate object/scene.

The source is dim soft olivegreen/brown/gray painted garment atlas ENTIRE64x64. Preserve ONE broad olivepaint field on the left with its original subdued shading and darklowertransition, ONE continuous curving gray paintedboundary from native x43 near top through x45 at y16/24,x44y32,x39y40,x31y48,x24y56 to bottomleft, ONE original short soft gold/brown paintedstroke at bottomleft, and ONE indistinct warmbrown wash at upperright. Keep ALL original thin vertical gray/dark painttraces in the rightfield with their old positions, widths, endings and weakphase. These are originalpaintdomains, NOT newly countable physical trim/piping/buckle/ornament parts. The tiny upperright brownpattern remains equally indistinct soft pigment without invented embroidery/medallion/loops/letters/gold relief.

Confirmed source broad paint-domain counts: {"entire_canvas": 1, "original_broad_olive_paint_domain": 1, "original_curving_gray_paint_boundary": 1, "original_lowerleft_gold_paint_stroke_domain": 1, "original_topright_indistinct_brown_paint_domain": 1}. Keep source literal weakpigment patterns/phases/soft transitions. No physical part counts are inferred from local RGBmaxima. ALL sourcealpha is255 including authoredblack RGB; black is NOTtransparent. FulloriginalA will be restored independently. Preserve opaque authored darksupport and allfullcanvas edges.
